repairTracks.description: Repair confirmed behavior defects or safety-critical regression gaps before cosmetic work.

Align public purchase/activation claims, billing configuration, entitlement authority, and canonical monetization classification. Do not expand Pro rollout while product-scoped authority is staged or billing is unavailable.
Add behavior-level automated coverage for defining transforms, failure paths, storage boundaries, network contracts, exports, and entitlement gates where required by the strict audit standard.
Repair recurring shared on-page issues such as Organization logo schema omissions, duplicate H1s, metadata length, and genuinely thin intent copy without mass-padding every tool.
Give each HOLD tool an explicit KEEP, PROMOTE, REBUILD, or ARCHIVE disposition before it can leave HOLD_REVIEW.

completionGate: All non-HOLD tools must reach strict PASS after repair and re-audit; each HOLD tool must receive an explicit disposition.
